description: This source file implements auxiliary PID control logic for a motor engine management system, including thread management, PWM control, and configuration handling.

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: PID controller class managing proportional, integral, and derivative control variables.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Logging utility class used for debug output.

classes.name: LocalVersionHolder
classes.description: Holds version information for configuration comparison.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether a specific auxiliary PID is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: pidReset
methods.description: Resets the PID controller's internal state.

methods.name: auxPidThread
methods.description: Main control loop thread for auxiliary PID operation.

methods.name: turnAuxPidOn
methods.description: Initializes and starts PWM for a specified auxiliary PID if enabled.

methods.name: startAuxPins
methods.description: Starts all auxiliary PIDs by initializing their PWM control.

methods.name: stopAuxPins
methods.description: Stops all auxiliary PIDs and releases control of associated pins.

methods.name: initAuxPid
methods.description: Initializes auxiliary PID control system, including thread creation and starting PWM outputs.
